slides.say: A rule for refs: do not read or write ref dot current while rendering.
React does not know when ref dot current changes. So even reading it while rendering makes your component unpredictable.

slides.text: Needed to render? It should be state. Refs belong in event handlers and Effects.
slides.say: If the value is needed for rendering, use state instead. Read and write refs in event handlers and Effects.
The only exception: setting a ref once on the first render, like this. It runs only when the ref is still empty.
